section.5: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

5.name_native: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Mu’aiqib said:“The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, concerning smoothing the pebbles during prayer: ‘If you must do that, then do it only once.’”
